response.original_title: ((ADD-ROOM))How do I add a room on Norwegian Cruise Line reservation?
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line reservation, you cannot do it online. You must call Norwegian Cruise Line directly at ☎ +1-866-829-1280 (US) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) Norwegian Cruise Line) or contact your travel agent to create a new, separate booking and link it to your current reservation.
